core.headline: New three-bedroom semi-detached house, Kings Hill, West Malling
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house, The Larch, on a development at Kings Hill, West Malling. Completion is expected in spring 2027. The property has an air source heat pump with underfloor heating to the ground floor, and benefits from a 10-year NHBC warranty.

The ground floor comprises an open-plan kitchen/dining room 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). On the first floor are three bedrooms, the principal measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with patio. Two allocated parking spaces are provided, with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: B (predicted). No onward chain. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion.
